title: LeNet-5 — 1998 Proceedings of the IEEE Publication Milestone
summary: In November 1998, Yann LeCun, Léon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio, and Patrick Haffner published "Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition" in Proceedings of the IEEE. The paper describes gradient-based learning for document recognition and presents the LeNet-5 convolutional neural-network architecture in that publication context.
significance: A directly identifiable publication milestone for LeNet-5 and gradient-trained convolutional neural networks in document recognition. LINEAiGE records the November 1998 publication milestone without treating it as the invention date of convolutional neural networks, LeNet's first implementation date, or a universal system-birth date.
organizations: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE)

verification.note: The IEEE publication metadata and DOI identify the article, authors, Proceedings of the IEEE volume 86 issue 11, pages 2278-2324, and November 1998 publication context. An author-hosted copy is available from Yann LeCun's publication archive. This candidate is limited to the November 1998 publication/documentation milestone and does not infer an exact publication day, first implementation date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
